title: DFPI announces investigation into MyConstant
publisher: California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation
notes: Regulatory alert reporting that MyConstant paused consumer deposits and withdrawals on 17 November 2022. The alert relays the operator's market-condition explanation without establishing an independently adjudicated cause.

title: DFPI reports MyConstant's intended orderly liquidation
publisher: California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation
notes: Regulatory alert reporting MyConstant's 25 November 2022 customer message about an intended orderly liquidation. It is not evidence that distributions began, that recoveries were maximized, or that liquidation completed.

title: DFPI orders MyConstant to cease offering crypto-related products
publisher: California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation
notes: Primary regulatory source for the California cease order and the regulator's findings concerning MyConstant's peer-to-peer lending, crypto interest, and fiat interest products.

title: DFPI description of MyConstant product structures
publisher: California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation
notes: Regulatory description of three distinct product families: crypto-collateralized peer-to-peer loan brokering, a fixed-yield crypto account, and a fixed-return fiat account. It does not provide the full historical customer agreements, custody terms, collateral waterfall, or liquidation distribution rules.
